data.title: 诱宵美九 · 后台休息室的露肩紫裙
data.description: 演唱会落幕后的专属贵宾休息室，灯光调成了梦幻的深紫与暖金交织色调。美九侧卧在奢华的天鹅绒长椅上，身上换下了华丽的灵装，穿着一袭轻柔随性的淡紫色露肩针织衫。银紫色的长马尾垂落在光洁如脂的裸肩上，她修长美指轻轻卷着发尾，紫眸流转着摄人心魄的歌姬魅力，含情脉脉地凝视着你。
data.location: private locked VIP dressing suite with plush velvet couch
data.action: reclining on velvet couch in VIP green room, casual lavender off-shoulder knit top, silver-purple hair cascading, twisting hair with finger, alluring diva smile
data.lighting: dreamy ambient purple and gold backstage dressing room lights
data.mood: enchanting pop-diva sensuality, intimate backstage confession
data.promptProse: Reclining on a plush velvet sofa in her private backstage dressing room, Miku wears a soft lavender off-shoulder knit top. Her silver-purple ponytail spills over bare shoulders as she smiles with irresistible pop-star allure.
data.animaCaption: Miku reclining on a dressing room couch in an off-shoulder lavender top, smiling enchantingly.
